text:
sam_ops: FYI scheduling a rolling NIC microcode + warm GPU host reboot window tomorrow 01:30-03:00 UTC for az6/az7. Small cohorts, non-draining.
leo_sre: How many GPUs will be out per cohort? need numbers for autoscaler.
sam_ops: Planning 6 hosts every 20m, ~72 GPUs offline per cohort (~2.2% regional). Can bump to 9/20m if backfill is healthy.
nina_oncall: Note: az6 has a couple legacy BMCs (rack-11) that add ~8m boot time. Stagger those racks.
raj_infra: Runbook will cordon/drain then vm-reboot. Command snippet: `kubectl cordon $n && kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then `vmctrl reboot $host`.
leo_sre: Flip autoscaler into warm-backfill at T-10m and set scale-up cooldown to 12m to avoid cost spike. I'll handle it.
sam_ops: Ops-bot: window created 1769997777; cohorts: az6-east (racks 8-9), az7-west (racks 1-3). Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/mini-maint-1769997777
nina_oncall: Netops: enable egress cap at 125% baseline for the window. We saw a 15% burst last time due to KV reseed.
leo_sre: Alert rules: abort if p95 token latency > 220ms for 3m OR error rate > 0.5% sustained. Oncall paged.
sam_ops: Customer note draft: "Planned rolling maintenance in region XYZ (01:30-03:00 UTC). Brief, localized latency increases possible; no API changes expected. Pinned dedicated customers: contact support." Approve?
raj_infra: LGTM. Will tag nodes with `maintenance=1769997777` so telemetry filters are easy.
ops-bot: status update scheduled 30m before start: https://status.redwood/incident/1769997777
leo_sre: I'll run a dry-run tonight at 22:15 UTC on a test node and post metrics.
sam_ops: Thanks — post results here and we'll finalize customer comms.
